content: Alcohol Use Disorder (AUD) is a medical condition where a person is unable to stop or control their alcohol use despite negative social, occupational, or health consequences.

AUD exists on a spectrum from mild to severe. It is diagnosed based on 11 criteria defined by the DSM-5, including things like craving alcohol, failing to cut down, and continued use despite problems.
Recovery is possible. With the right support, treatment, and resources, many people with AUD go on to live healthy, fulfilling lives.
